dimensions.summary: Standalone jobs, export map, CLI envelope and packed G1/G4/G6/G7 fixtures preserve one graph truth without a central CLI runtime.
Packed jobs cover every published query preset and reject path; query-cache injection and workspace onboarding fail closed independently of root incremental APIs.
Synthetic retrieval scored from the packed tarball remains labelled non-public; truncated rows stay out of accuracy aggregates.
Packed tarball rejects host-path leakage, secret material, source maps and governance artifacts; invalid G1 corpus stays fail-closed.
Query-cache latest aliases are rejected from packed consumers and query result envelopes still omit a cache field.
Local G7 checks pass; internal standalone admission still requires retained G6 OS-matrix evidence and an internal adoption decision.
Root exports, packed jobs and the standalone executable do not import the central CLI runtime.
Packed CLI jobs, G1/G4/G6/G7 fixture admission and synthetic retrieval scored from the installed tarball are deterministic and identity-locked.
Release inventory pins public exports, schema digests, packed jobs and the distributed conformance profile.
Workspace inspect without an onboarding adapter stays partial and incident/rollback classes remain unattested and unproven.
G7 product-surface, packed-consumer, SBOM, retrieval and inventory gates have dedicated tests and package scripts.
CycloneDX SBOM and private packed contents are locally verified; public npm publication is intentionally outside the current architecture.

checks.evidence: Package-owned build, contract, test, runtime, packed-consumer, SBOM, inventory and G7 admission gates pass locally.
All G7 stage-plan checkpoints except internal-promotion-and-rollback-verification are implemented-local-candidate.

The fail-closed G7 release-candidate matrix is implemented and chained to same-run G6 evidence. Retained remote results plus internal promotion and rollback proof remain required before standalone admission.
The package-owned admission ledger verifies the private Shared workspace dependency and rejects stability while Graph lacks final internal contracts plus promotion and rollback proof.

remainingRisks: Internal standalone admission still requires retained same-commit Linux, macOS and Windows G6 evidence plus an internal adoption decision.
The private @workspai/shared runtime dependency must remain exact, lockfile-bound and covered by packed-consumer checks.
The CycloneDX SBOM is an internal artifact; public npm provenance is intentionally deferred.
Retrieval scores are synthetic and fixture-labelled; they cannot support a public accuracy claim.
Workspace composition from the packed executable remains partial until an injected onboarding adapter is supplied.
Rollback from internal Graph consumption to the existing CLI Graph path is not proven.
Rust, native and WASM acceleration remain prohibited.
Central CLI shadow parity and replacement remain prohibited until G8.

approval.rule: Standalone-stable admission, not this local closure, is the only authority that can open G8.
